findings.issue: Uses `initialPrompt` (boot state-summary: read HANDOFF.json + activity-feed, surface one-line state). `initialPrompt` is NOT on the documented plugin-agent field allowlist (name,description,model,effort,maxTurns,tools,disallowedTools,skills,memory,background,isolation). `claude plugin validate --strict` validates the manifest only and does not check agent .md frontmatter, so it neither flags nor confirms it. findings.fix: Confirm against current Claude Code agent docs whether `initialPrompt` is supported on plugin agents. If unsupported, move the boot-summary behavior into the orchestrator system prompt body (it already documents the same logic) so it does not depend on an unrecognized frontmatter key.
findings.resolution: Removed initialPrompt frontmatter; folded boot state-summary into system-prompt body §0. Confirmed unsupported via docs (agent field allowlist).

findings.issue: Orphan: documents /loop and /schedule but no SKILL.md links to /_shared/scheduling.md, though 7 loop-capable skills (next, sprint, code-sweep, browse, ui-audit, sprint-plan, sprint-dev) reference loop/scheduling concepts. Cited only by CHANGELOG + a docs/validation snapshot.
findings.fix: Link /_shared/scheduling.md from the loop-capable skills (esp. next, code-sweep) as the canonical scheduling backing, or fold into an existing referenced protocol.
findings.resolution: Linked from skills/next and skills/code-sweep (loop-capable); no longer orphan.

findings.issue: No authoritative engine minimum declared. Effective floor is implicit/inconsistent: lowest skill floor advertises >=2.1.71 but orchestrator main-thread activation needs >=2.1.117 and 9 wired hook events postdate 2.1.71. Consumers on 2.1.71-2.1.116 silently lose orchestrator routing + recent-event hooks.
findings.fix: Declare one authoritative minimum (>=2.1.117) so the advertised floor matches what the plugin actually delivers.
findings.resolution: Effective minimum (>=2.1.117) surfaced in plugin.json description; no engines field exists to declare it formally.

cross_cutting.issue: Verbatim trigger overlap: 'review sprint N','run review','check quality' (sprint-review even claims 'audit sprint'). Hand-off ('review delegates to sprint-review') is one-directional and buried; neither carries a reciprocal use-X-when boundary.
cross_cutting.fix: review: 'per-change/pre-commit precision review of a diff; for the full end-of-sprint 8-invariant gate use sprint-review.' sprint-review: 'full end-of-sprint gate; for lightweight per-change review use /blitz:review.'
cross_cutting.resolution: review desc → per-change front door + 'use sprint-review for full gate'; sprint-review desc dropped 'check quality'/'run review', added 'use review for per-change'.

cross_cutting.issue: ship and release list the exact same triggers 'cut a release','release v1.X'. release notes it is 'composed by ship' (weak); ship has no clause for when to prefer release alone.
cross_cutting.fix: Keep 'cut a release'/'release vX' on ship (full gated chain); release owns 'publish/tag/rollback' in isolation. Add reciprocal boundaries.
cross_cutting.resolution: ship keeps 'cut a release'/'release vX' + boundary to release; release dropped those verbatim triggers, added 'use ship for full chain'.

cross_cutting.issue: Bare 'audit'/'security audit' overloaded across 5 components with no shared object-noun key. Object nouns mostly disambiguate (deps->dep-health, firestore->code-doctor, consistency->ui-audit, sprint->sprint-review, codebase->audit) but bare 'audit' and 'security audit' genuinely collide between audit (5-pillar incl Security) and dep-health (CVE scan).
cross_cutting.fix: audit: narrow security claim to 'source-code security'; route dependency CVE to dep-health. Add object-noun routing note; bare 'audit' with no object -> /blitz:ask.
cross_cutting.resolution: audit 'security audit'→'source-code security audit'; added object-noun routing (deps→dep-health, firestore→code-doctor, UI→ui-audit, sprint→sprint-review, bare→ask).

cross_cutting.issue: 'implement sprint'/'resume sprint' match all three. implement/sprint-dev is a benign alias; sprint vs the pair is a real fork (bare 'implement' should not trigger the full plan->implement->review cycle).
cross_cutting.fix: sprint: 'only for full plan->implement->review cycle; for implementation-only use /blitz:implement.' implement: mark as thin alias of sprint-dev.
cross_cutting.resolution: sprint desc: 'only full plan→implement→review cycle; for impl-only use /blitz:implement or /blitz:sprint-dev'. implement marked thin router.

cross_cutting.issue: 'analyze this project/codebase' has no single owner across codebase-map (onboarding map), architect (coupling/dep-graph), audit (quality findings); research shares the verb 'analyze'.
cross_cutting.fix: Add inverse one-liners: codebase-map=onboarding map, architect=structural/dep-graph, audit=quality/tech-debt.
cross_cutting.resolution: codebase-map desc: added 'structural→architect agent, quality→/blitz:audit' boundary.

cross_cutting.issue: 'visual audit' triggers both browse (functional smoke: console/network/screenshots) and ui-audit (semantic data consistency/role-leak).
cross_cutting.fix: Remove/qualify 'visual audit' on browse to 'visual smoke test'; ui-audit owns cross-page data consistency.
cross_cutting.resolution: browse desc: 'visual audit'→'visual smoke test' + 'cross-page data→/blitz:ui-audit' boundary.

cross_cutting.issue: Name-adjacency cluster. Verified disambiguators are accurate (critic vs reviewer; research-critic vs critic). All resolve to distinct ids. Gap: reviewer has no 'Different from...' clause; test-gen/test-writer & doc-gen/doc-writer skill/agent pairs lack 'I am the worker agent' markers.
cross_cutting.fix: Add worker-agent markers to reviewer/test-writer/doc-writer; no id clash exists.
cross_cutting.resolution: Added worker-agent markers to reviewer/test-writer/doc-writer descriptions; reviewer now carries Different-from critic/review clause.

cross_cutting.issue: No single engine minimum. Orchestrator activation needs >=2.1.117; 9 wired events postdate 2.1.71 (TeammateIdle, PostToolBatch, PostToolUseFailure, StopFailure, WorktreeCreate, WorktreeRemove, SubagentStart, UserPromptExpansion, PostCompact). Consumers on 2.1.71-2.1.116 silently lose orchestrator routing + those hooks while plugin advertises 2.1.71.
cross_cutting.fix: Declare authoritative >=2.1.117 minimum in plugin.json; keep per-skill higher floors (design-extract 2.1.117, health 2.1.152).
cross_cutting.resolution: No plugin.json engines field exists (would fail --strict); surfaced effective min >=2.1.117 in plugin.json description instead of falsifying per-skill floors.

cross_cutting.issue: All 38 ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} references in hooks.json are unquoted (0 quoted). Docs example quotes it; unquoted breaks on install paths containing spaces.
cross_cutting.fix: Quote every "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/hooks/scripts/*.sh in hooks.json (single mechanical pass).
cross_cutting.resolution: Quoted all 38 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" command values; updated validate-plugin-structure.sh to strip quotes when resolving.

cross_cutting.issue: Plain `Stop` event not wired (StopFailure + SubagentStop are, as logging stubs). Omission is undocumented; turn-end persistence handled out-of-band via PreCompact + model-written activity-feed. Plausibly intentional but unconfirmed.
cross_cutting.fix: Add a one-line rationale note (or a Stop logging stub) to remove ambiguity.
cross_cutting.resolution: Added "Stop — intentionally not wired" rationale section to hooks/scripts/README.md.

cross_cutting.issue: Undeclared external deps: Playwright MCP (browse, ui-build, ui-audit, design-critic) and Gemini CLI (critic-gemini.sh, opt-in via BLITZ_USE_GEMINI_CRITIC/BLITZ_DUAL_CRITIC). plugin.json.dependencies is empty.
cross_cutting.fix: Document the optional external deps in plugin.json or a prerequisites note; both are genuinely external/unbundled (Gemini path is correctly opt-in via env var).
cross_cutting.resolution: Documented Playwright MCP + Gemini CLI external deps in plugin.json description (dependencies field is plugin-only).

cross_cutting.issue: counts.json (37/10/32/38/16) matches disk exactly; validate-plugin-structure (284 checks), check-count-sync, check-version-sync all PASS; plugin manifest strict-validates clean. No drift.
cross_cutting.fix: None — count/version integrity is clean and CI-enforced.
cross_cutting.resolution: No action — integrity clean and CI-enforced.
